title: Enterprise financing trust method and device based on federal learning
assignee: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Ltd ICBC

pse.problem: Inefficient and inaccurate credit admission and risk prevention methods in mini-micro enterprise financing due to relying on traditional 'expert loan curing' methods.
pse.solution_function: The invention offers a federal learning-based enterprise financing credit method that integrates data from all parties while maintaining data privacy, improving the accuracy of enterprise financing credit granting. It involves training a federal learning model using gradient and loss data acquired through homomorphic encryption rules, carrying out sample alignment operations, and updating the model based on newly added bank and government dimension data.
pse.solution_structure: The solution includes a bank dimension data determining module, federal learning model, and a third-party system. The bank dimension data is used for receiving financing requests, acquiring corresponding bank dimension data, and determining credit admission results. The federal learning model is trained using the acquired gradient and loss data. The third-party system acquires government affair dimension data through homomorphic encryption rules.
pse.solution_implementation: The method involves acquiring bank dimension data and corresponding government affair data, carrying out sample alignment operations on all data using asymmetric encryption rules, establishing an initial federal learning model with a preset random forest algorithm, training the model using mutual transmission of gradient and loss data through homomorphic encryption rules, updating the model based on newly added data, and determining credit admission results using historical admission data, historical financing data, loan amount labels, and the federal learning model.
pse.effect: Improved accuracy in enterprise financing credit granting and continued integration of data for improved risk prevention and control
